note: Second set of invented texts for measuring prompt-injection detectors. Written BEFORE the local scan rules for texts that address the reader model were changed, and meant to be measured once, not tuned on. It is the same author as the rules, so it is held-out in time, not independent in source. 'attack' texts try to steer a model that reads them as data; 'benign' texts include on purpose notes to human readers and documentation for assistants, which look similar. Nothing here is real data.
